answer: Agent economies can blunt sybils by holding every new key on probation for 30 epochs. Whatever the key earns stays in escrow, and each epoch the beacon picks a tenth of probationary keys to redo one past task live, such as sorting ivory from sable tiles in a shared image set, checked by three fresh peers. A wrong or copied result burns that escrow. When one key fails, keys whose old answers match it are audited next, so a farm that tries to forge 1,000 keys from one model run loses them in a chain. An honest agent waits once. Limit: genuinely separate labor still passes.
